messages:
jess_acme: Hey team — our billing for embeddings spiked yesterday. Dashboard shows 'units' = 98,000 but our token totals are ~49k. Looks like units are being double-counted (vectors vs tokens). Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/snap1.png Account: ACME-123. Example request id: req_8f7a2. Can someone help?

alex_support: Thanks Jess — sorry for the disruption. I'm opening an internal case. Can you DM the account id and paste any API response headers you received (X-Embeddings-Units / X-Request-Id) and a timestamp so we can repro quickly? cc @maria_cs

maria_cs: Filed CS-9872 and looped billing. Will follow up with credits if this looks like platform billing error.

jess_acme: Pasting the headers we captured at ~2026-02-23T18:12Z:
```
X-Request-Id: req_8f7a2
X-Embeddings-Units: 512
X-Embed-Token-Count: 256
```
Also the dashboard export CSV attached (link): https://acme.s3/exports/embeds-20260223.csv

alex_support: Got it. Quick triage note: we rolled a change to the analytics ETL last week that added a couple of alias fields. Looping @sam_eng_analytics to check if frontend aggregation is summing aliases.

sam_eng_analytics: On it. Can you share the dashboard query id or the timeframe you used? I want to run the same aggregation against raw events.

alex_support: Dashboard panel id is panel-embeds-42, timeframe Feb 22 00:00 - Feb 23 23:59. Here's a snippet from the exported query we saw in logs:
```sql
-- analytics raw count snapshot
SELECT sum(vectors) as s1, sum(tokens) as s2, sum(vector_count) as s3
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE account_id = 'ACME-123' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-22' AND '2026-02-23'
```
We noticed s1 + s3 ~= dashboard 'units' value.

sam_eng_analytics: Reproduced locally. Root cause: ETL commit c6a7f8 introduced a legacy alias 'vector_count' while also populating 'vectors'. The dashboard front-end aggregates both fields (naively summing all numeric unit fields). I'll push a hotfix to stop double-aggregating aliases.

sam_eng_analytics: Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/1127 — patch removes alias from ingestion and updates dashboard mapping. Deploying to staging in 10m.

billing_bot: Billing action: provisional credit of $5,000 created for ACME-123 (credit-id: CR-2026-ACME123). Pending finance approval FIN-432.

alex_support: Interim customer-facing workaround: on the Dashboard use filter unit_type = "vectors" or switch to the raw_tokens metric. I'll add a short support note with steps.

sam_eng_analytics: Deployed hotfix to prod at 2026-02-24T02:40Z (deploy id: deploy-analytics-2.14.3). Reindex job started; dashboards will reflect corrected counts once reindex completes (ETA ~10m). Root cause summary: ETL alias + front-end aggregation logic changed behavior after the alias was introduced.

deploy-bot: deploy: analytics-service v2.14.3-hotfix rolled by sam_eng_analytics at 1782014000.

alex_support: @jess_acme can you confirm numbers once your dashboard refreshes?

jess_acme: Verified — numbers now match our token totals, spike gone. Thank you, team. The provisional credit looks fine. :heart:

maria_cs: Closing CS-9872 after confirmation from customer. I'll schedule a short postmortem with eng-analytics to capture timeline and prevention steps.

sam_eng_analytics: Will follow up with a brief postmortem and add an automated test to prevent future alias/aggregation collisions.

alex_support: Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.
